name: Paradip Port

LOA/beam (290m/45m) are inferred from the stated 165,000 DWT Capesize class capability, not an independently sourced berth dimension — flag if a more precise official berth-table figure surfaces later.
source: CareRatings credit rating report on Paradip Port (port-level draft); Bothra Group (KICT terminal operator) capability page
